note: Qwen3.8-27B on one DGX Spark (TP=1), engine install/atlas-source-27b.json. The checkpoint is nvidia/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 with TandemLLM's NVFP4 Gated DeltaNet and attention projections in place of its FP8 GDN and the engine's load-time NVFP4 attention (install/checkpoint-27b.json overlay; 2.4 GB fewer bytes a decode step, +0.004 nats/token held-out NLL). DFlash2 block drafting (incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2, gamma 8) with exact verify, alone and batched, so it also speculates inside <think> with output byte-identical to serial decode; row-invariant tensor-core projection kernels for decode and verify (ATLAS_SKINNY_MMA); W4A8 prefill on BF16 tensor cores (NLL equal to or better than the default path), fused GDN decode, and each sequence's exact GDN verify rows in one launch per layer, with their state committed afterwards by replaying only the accepted rows. BF16 KV, prefix caching. Speculation follows the batch: 7 drafts a sequence up to eight live sequences, 3 up to sixteen, plain batched decode past that (every row stays exact). DRAFTER (SPARKQWEN_DRAFTER) picks the drafter: dflash2 (this argv, the default), dspine (tencent/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpine-b16 at gamma 16, install/serve.py) or both (DFlash2 and DSpine, routed per request by the engine). Configured limits: 64 concurrent requests, 262,144 tokens each, at util 0.85 (a KV pool of about 340K tokens). Siblings: 27b-max (both drafters, util 0.84) and 27b-saver (the smallest footprint). The MTP throughput gate is off (ATLAS_MTP_GATE_FORCE=1, as in the Flash-Next profiles): its 16-step serial probes (a refresh every 1,024 tokens, and on every context-depth doubling and batch-width change) cost about 10% at one request and 3-5% at eight, while a verify step here (about 72 ms for 8 rows) costs no more than a plain decode step. Past sixteen live requests the width rule still decodes plainly. While a long prompt prefills, the requests decoding beside it keep 30% of the time (ATLAS_DECODE_TIME_SHARE). Requests may run an hour (--request-timeout=3600): a 254K-token prompt prefills in about ten minutes. Not yet qualified.
